summary: Read the Mayville-Portland EDC page (headless): Park District campground, full and partial hookups, water/sewer/showers, reserve by phone at 701-430-7177 after 5 pm. Booking set reservable by phone; water/sewer/showers confirmed; note cleaned of field repeats. No official rate anywhere (Campendium $25 from 2018 only). Creekside not confirmed: loop road between the sites and the ~18 m Goose River -> downgrade lead to not waterfront.
flags: WATERFRONT (checked hard), DOWN lead creekside -> not waterfront: on Esri imagery the RV sites all sit inside a single gravel loop (centre ~47.4965,-97.3352); the Goose River here is ~17-20 m wide (creek-sized), and the loop road runs between every visible site and the grass bank, 30-40 m from the water. A campground's own loop road blocks on-water, and there is no creek-view value, so creekside is not earned. Site numbers unread (no site map published).

FEES: no official rate found (the EDC page, ND Tourism and the Park District post none; ND Tourism has no Willowood listing). Only Campendium's camper report of $25 (September 2018). No fee written; a phone call would settle it.

SITES: stored count 16 and max_rig_ft 45 (derived from the EDC page's older text) are no longer on the page; left as stored. ND HHS licenses WILLOWOOD (Mayville Park District) for 30 lots, likely counting tent sites; imagery shows about 14-16 RV spurs.
HOOKUPS: stored electric 50 is not on the current page; left as stored (the page says 'full and partial hook-ups').

LONG-STAY: the page calls it 'the perfect summer home away from home for campers'; imagery shows a modest number of rigs and no rows of skirted trailers. Not read as mostly seasonal; nightly share unmeasured.
PHONE: stored (701) 430-7177 confirmed (the EDC page's reservation line, after 5 pm). WEBSITE: the stored EDC page is still the only official page (live in a browser; Cloudflare refuses plain HTTP).

Daily, weekly, and monthly rates', (701) 430-8937; HHS licence 'EVANS CAMPGROUND', 8 lots, private). Not in campgrounds.json.
